title: Auto-regenerate changelog HTML across locales from centralized config
context: v1.12.0 release needed to appear in changelog with localized titles and date formats across multiple languages (ar, es, he, ru, en).
decision: Store locale-specific changelog titles and UI strings in tooling/changelog-locales.mjs, then regenerate all site/*/changelog/index.html files from this single source of truth. Each locale gets its own date format, title translation, and layout direction (RTL for he/ar).
consequences: Changelog stays synchronized across locales when source is updated
Locale-specific titles and translations maintained in one place, reducing drift
Date formats respect locale conventions (e.g., 'Aug 10, 2026' vs '10 de agosto de 2026')
HTML pages are reproducible artifacts, not manually edited
alternatives_rejected: Manually editing each locale's HTML changelog file separately
Single English changelog with manual post-hoc translations
Embedding locale logic into the HTML generation rather than data-driven config
